effect_description_eng:
＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash 1 card in your opponent's hand without looking.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's hand is trashed from, you may play 1 play cost 10 or lower purple card from your trash without paying the cost. For each card in your opponent's hand, reduce this effect's play cost maximum by 1.
